instructions: Halve the 2 avocados, take out the pits and scoop the flesh into a medium bowl.
Mash the avocado with a fork, leaving a few small chunks. Season it with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Toast the 4 slices of sourdough in the toaster until they're golden and crisp.
While the toast is still hot, cut the garlic clove in half and rub the cut side over the top of each slice.
Heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until it shimmers. Crack in the 4 eggs, leaving a little room between them.
Fry them for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set right up to the yolks and the edges are lightly crisp. The yolks stay runny. Sprinkle each egg with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread the avocado over the toast, all the way to the edges.
Slide an egg onto each toast and drizzle the rest of the olive oil over the top.
method_notes: All three read versions mash ripe avocado onto hot toast and season it with salt, and the egg goes on top. Spend With Pennies (the lead) mashes the avocado in a bowl, rubs the hot toast with a cut garlic clove, seasons with salt and pepper and finishes with good olive oil, listing a fried egg as its first topping. Love and Lemons adds a squeeze of lemon, and Food Network's California version keeps it to avocado, a fried egg, salt and pepper. None gives egg timings, so the egg here is fried in olive oil until the whites are set and the yolk is runny, one avocado for every two slices as the lead writes it.
